sections.title: The letter bé
paragraphs: The letter name is (bé) /beː/. It usually sounds as in (baba) /ˈbɒbɒ/, which means baby, doll. This letter has two sounds. The sound changes depending on the next consonant.

sections.title: How to say bé
paragraphs: Press both lips firmly together to stop the air. Release them suddenly while your voice is on. Put a hand on your throat to feel it shake. For the second sound, make the same quick burst with both lips. Keep your voice completely off. Your throat will not shake.

sections.title: Spelling and sounds
paragraphs: Usually, this letter sounds as in (jobb) /jobː/. It changes before a consonant made with no voice. There it sounds like the burst in (rabkocsi) /ˈrɒpkot͡ʃi/.

sections.title: Common mistakes
paragraphs: Do not whisper the main sound at the start of words like best. Turn your voice on before your lips open. Do not add a small puff of air when the sound changes. Make the burst clean, short and sharp.
